title: Mica under the Teotihuacan pyramids as technology
summary: Jim Weiner tells of Mica under the Teotihuacan pyramids as technology, about ancient at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Why did they have huge sheets of micica brought to Teaot Wakan Sun per pyramid from two to three thousand miles away in South America

plain: Jim Weiner, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, points to Teotihuacan, an ancient city in Mexico with a huge Pyramid of the Sun. He asks why huge sheets of mica, a mineral that splits into thin flat sheets, were brought there from two to three thousand miles away in South America. To him, that suggests the pyramids were built as some kind of technology.
